_comment: Seconds. catches[k] = when block k lands in his hands; he sets it into the wall (3 columns x 4 rows, bottom row first, left to right) at catches[k] + place. throwers[k] = which grey man throws it (they shout the word on the wind-up: shoutLead s before release). The red block is thrown at redRelease, smashes into the wall at redHit, bounces and hits the floor at redLand.
